releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.0.7 — OmniMotion AI Native FrameGen & Force FrameGen Engine:
- OmniMotion AI Native: Custom in-house 2X/3X frame generation engine built from scratch using DWM MMCSS, sub-millisecond QPC cadence synchronization, and 0.8ms zero-lag presentation.
- Force DLSS 3 Optical Flow: Unlocks and forces NVIDIA Ada Optical Flow hardware acceleration even in games without official in-game toggles.
- Force Universal Lossless Scaling (LSFG): Auto-hooks into windowed/borderless games and injects 2X/3X frame multiplication.
- Dynamic Mode Lighting: The selected FrameGen engine dynamically illuminates with a glowing neon accent fill.
- In-Game HUD: Real-time FrameGen mode indicator.
